Model comparison results for demand forecasting:

- XGBoost: MAE = 2.77 units, RMSE = 3.47 units, MAPE = 43.6%
- ARIMA: MAE = 3.55 units, RMSE = 4.46 units, MAPE = 55.7%
- Naive (lag_1): MAE = 3.54 units, RMSE = 4.46 units, MAPE = 49.2%

Best performing model: XGBoost with MAE of 2.77 units.

The XGBoost model outperformed the naive baseline (predict tomorrow = today) by approximately 22% on MAE. This demonstrates that the model learned genuine demand patterns beyond simple repetition.

Top predictive features: rolling_mean_14 (25.2% importance), rolling_mean_7 (17.0%), demand_type (12.5%). This confirms that recent demand trends and part category are the strongest drivers of future demand.

Demand type: NPI (New Product Introduction)

NPI parts are components for newly launched semiconductor equipment. Demand pattern is characterized by sudden spikes when a new product is announced, followed by gradual stabilization. NPI demand is the hardest to predict (highest MAPE) due to its volatile, event-driven nature. Safety stock should be 20-30% above average to buffer against forecast uncertainty. Example parts: AMAT-RF-7800-GEN (RF generator), AMAT-LITH-5500-ALIGN (lithography alignment sensor).

Demand type: standard (Standard replacement parts)

Standard parts are routine replacement components that factories consistently need. Demand pattern is steady and predictable with low variance. These parts have the lowest MAPE (best forecast accuracy). Safety stock can be minimal (5-10% above average) since demand is reliable. Example parts: AMAT-CVD-3200-VALVE (gas delivery valve), AMAT-CVD-3200-SEAL (chamber seal ring).

Demand type: service_campaign (Service campaign and warranty parts)

Service campaign parts see demand spikes during product recalls, warranty programs, or field upgrade campaigns. Demand pattern shows sharp spikes when a campaign launches, then drops back to baseline when the campaign ends. Forecast accuracy is moderate. Safety stock should be increased 2-4 weeks before a planned campaign. Example parts: AMAT-CMP-4100-PAD (polishing pad), AMAT-CMP-4100-SLURRY (slurry pump).

Demand type: reliability (Reliability and wear parts)

Reliability parts are components that degrade over time through normal use. Demand pattern shows gradual, steady increase as the installed base of equipment ages. These parts are moderately predictable. Safety stock should increase proportionally with the installed base growth rate. Example: AMAT-ETCH-6600-RING (etch chamber focus ring that wears out).
